description: React component for an intern dashboard page, including submission form and history, managing in-memory data.

methods.name: isoToDayLabel
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to the corresponding day name.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string for submissions.

methods.name: loadForEdit
methods.description: Loads a submission into the form for editing.

methods.name: onDateChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the date input, auto-filling the day label.

methods.name: onFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input changes, creating object URLs for image previews.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, adding or updating a submission in state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a submission from the in-memory list.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form fields and revokes object URLs.
